name: Example: Utilizing the Periodicity Property of the Cotangent Function
problem: If $\cot x = 1$ for some $x,$ then find the value of $\cot(x+5\pi).$
worked_solution:
The period of $y = \cot x$ is $\pi.$ Therefore, for any integer $n,$ we have

$$
\cot{x} = \cot{(x+n\pi)} .
$$

Substituting $n=5$ into the above gives

$$
\begin{aligned}cot⁡x & =cot⁡(x+5\cdot \pi ) \\  & =cot⁡(x+5\pi ).\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, if $\cot{x} = 1,$ then $\cot{(x+5\pi)} = 1.$
